rules: new source onboarding starts as candidate and may not silently become active
canonical identity, provider mapping, pack membership, and origin are separate decisions
provider or domain names may not define canonical identity
pack membership must be explicit and may not be inferred from language
any declared UNKNOWN capability fails closed for promotion; UNSUPPORTED remains a valid explicit capability state
authentication, webview, challenge, shared-runtime, or equivalent higher-risk behavior requires stronger evidence than build success
runtime smoke evidence is mandatory for a new source
required evidence and proof fields must contain the exact candidateRevision, not merely non-empty labels
a failed or incomplete candidate never replaces last-known-good state
promotion requires the existing source_onboarding authority, the exact required gate set, and explicit owner approval
onboarding validation may not mutate stable release state or bypass promotion authority
